main_record.driver:
"""Inspect Cirq-derived CZ invariants with symmetric temporary-function controls."""
from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import contextlib
import cProfile
import hashlib
import itertools
import json
import pstats
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import tracemalloc
from collections.abc import Iterator
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from typing import Any
from unittest.mock import patch

ROOT = Path.cwd()
HARNESS = Path('/private/tmp/sdkbench-product-conformance-20261121')
BASE = '7d2e13c4160c0c1546d61a41551189fa11615465'
SOURCE_PATH = 'flagquantum/compiler/optimization/_cz_blocks.py'
OUTPUT = Path('/private/tmp/fq-cirq-invariant-controls-20261122.json')

def git(folder: Path, *arguments: str) -> str:
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *arguments], cwd=folder, text=True, timeout=15).strip()

assert git(HARNESS, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD') == '9aa9260920984e2ca05bcb293abb885fccd9c144'
assert not git(HARNESS, 'status', '--porcelain')
sys.path.insert(0, str(HARNESS / 'src'))
from flagquantum.compiler.optimization import _cz_blocks as synthesis
from flagquantum.compiler.optimization.two_qubit_synthesis import _determinant
from flagquantum.compiler import optimize
from flagquantum.core.ir import CircuitIR, Instruction
from sdkbench.candidates.adapters import load_adapter, workflow_configuration
from sdkbench.candidates.applications import fixture
from sdkbench.p0 import Bundle
from sdkbench.p0.evaluators import routing

original = synthesis._candidate
baseline_source = (ROOT / SOURCE_PATH).read_text()
candidate_source = Path('/private/tmp/fq-proposed-cirq-invariant-blocks-20261122.py').read_text()
def cloned_function(text: str, filename: str) -> Any:
    node = next(item for item in ast.parse(text).body if isinstance(item, ast.FunctionDef) and item.name == '_candidate')
    namespace = dict(vars(synthesis))
    namespace["_determinant"] = _determinant
    for helper in ast.parse(text).body:
        if isinstance(helper, ast.FunctionDef) and helper.name == "_cannot_reduce_cz":
            exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[helper],type_ignores=[]),filename,"exec"),namespace)
    exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[node],type_ignores=[]),filename,'exec'),namespace)
    return namespace['_candidate']

baseline = cloned_function(baseline_source, 'balanced-original-cz-blocks')
candidate = cloned_function(candidate_source, 'balanced-proposed-cirq-invariants')
patch_locations = [(module, key) for module_name,module in tuple(sys.modules.items()) if module_name.startswith('flagquantum.') and module is not None for key,value in tuple(vars(module).items()) if value is original]
assert patch_locations
assert baseline is not original and candidate is not original

@contextlib.contextmanager
def variant(name: str) -> Iterator[None]:
    selected = baseline if name == 'baseline' else candidate
    try:
        with contextlib.ExitStack() as stack:
            for module,key in patch_locations:
                assert getattr(module,key) is original
                stack.enter_context(patch.object(module,key,selected))
            yield
    finally:
        assert all(getattr(module,key) is original for module,key in patch_locations)

def observe(case: tuple[int, str, str], workflow: str, *, trace: bool = False) -> dict[str, Any]:
    width, family, topology = case
    bundle = Bundle(HARNESS / 'docs/implementation')
    acceptance = bundle.cases['ROUTE-GRID-08' if width == 8 else f'ROUTE-LINE-{width:02d}']
    config = workflow_configuration(workflow)
    adapter = load_adapter(SimpleNamespace(configuration={'options': {'sdk': config['sdk'], 'workflow': workflow, 'compiler_options': config}}))
    source = fixture(width, family, topology, '01' * 32)
    seed = bundle.plan['execution_profile']['compiler_seeds'][0]
    if trace:
        tracemalloc.start()
    try:
        start = time.perf_counter()
        payload = adapter.execute('route', source, seed)
        seconds = time.perf_counter() - start
        peak = tracemalloc.get_traced_memory()[1] if trace else None
    finally:
        if trace:
            tracemalloc.stop()
    metrics = routing(payload, source, None, acceptance, 0)
    assert payload['final_layout'] == list(range(width))
    normalized = json.dumps({key: payload[key] for key in ('operations', 'final_layout')}, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False)
    return {'metrics': metrics, 'normalized_output_sha256': hashlib.sha256(normalized.encode()).hexdigest(), 'audit': dict(adapter.audit), 'seconds': seconds, 'compiler_python_peak_bytes': peak}

report: dict[str, Any] = {'implementation_commit': git(ROOT, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'), 'base_commit': BASE, 'source_commit': git(HARNESS, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'), 'scope': 'Inspected single-device shared macOS development controls, one numerical thread; no qualified timing, process RSS, prospective, SDK ranking or scalability claim', 'baseline_source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(baseline_source.encode()).hexdigest(), 'candidate_source': candidate_source, 'baseline_scope': 'Only native CZ candidate generation may conservatively reject two/three-CZ blocks from Cirq characteristic invariants when the raw 43-operation bound fits. Strict unitary guard, margin 1e-6, no cache, existing numerical synthesis and independent replay unchanged.', 'driver': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'protocol': {'implementation_commit': '9e23002afc78de142e113f6e7e81e365e6a843ff', 'published_before_execution': True}, 'observer': {'both_variants_use_parsed_function_definitions': True, 'module_patch_locations_cached_once': True, 'same_patch_setup_and_teardown': True, 'patch_locations': [module.__name__ + '.' + key for module,key in patch_locations], 'garbage_collection_policy_changed': False}, 'complete': False, 'rows': [], 'timing': [], 'memory': [], 'profiles': []}

def checkpoint() -> None:
    OUTPUT.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')

for workflow in ('flagquantum-ordinary-restored', 'flagquantum-target-artifact'):
    for index, case in enumerate(itertools.product((6, 8, 12), ('qaoa', 'ising', 'hopping', 'qft', 'repetition'), ('line', 'ring', 'grid', 'sparse'))):
        observations = {}
        for mode in (('baseline', 'candidate') if index % 2 == 0 else ('candidate', 'baseline')):
            with variant(mode):
                observations[mode] = observe(case, workflow)
        assert all(observations['baseline'][key] == observations['candidate'][key] for key in ('metrics', 'normalized_output_sha256', 'audit')), (workflow, case, observations)
        report['rows'].append({'workflow': workflow, 'case': case, 'observations': observations})
        checkpoint()
    print('Accepted all 60 paired workflows:', workflow, flush=True)

for case in ((6, 'qft', 'grid'), (6, 'repetition', 'ring'), (12, 'qft', 'grid')):
    samples = {'baseline': [], 'candidate': []}
    for iteration in range(11):
        for mode in (('baseline', 'candidate') if iteration % 2 == 0 else ('candidate', 'baseline')):
            with variant(mode):
                observed = observe(case, 'flagquantum-target-artifact')
            if iteration >= 2:
                samples[mode].append(observed['seconds'])
    report['timing'].append({'case': case, 'workflow': 'flagquantum-target-artifact', 'warmups_per_variant': 2, 'samples_seconds': samples, 'median_seconds': {mode: statistics.median(values) for mode, values in samples.items()}})
    for mode in ('baseline', 'candidate'):
        with variant(mode):
            observed = observe(case, 'flagquantum-target-artifact', trace=True)
            peak = observed['compiler_python_peak_bytes']
        report['memory'].append({'case': case, 'mode': mode, 'python_peak_bytes': peak, 'scope': 'adapter.execute only, matching the timed compilation stage; fixture/configuration and independent evaluator excluded; Python traced allocations, not process RSS'})
    checkpoint()
    print(case, report['timing'][-1]['median_seconds'], flush=True)
report['complete'] = True
checkpoint()
